how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:96607:title: The Great Outdoors [⟦E5⟧]
rows.quest:96607:obj:0: Sit near 's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
rows.quest:96607:details:1: Well howdy there, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:3: Lok-tar, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:5: Greetings, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:6: You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
rows.quest:96607:details:7: Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
rows.quest:96607:progress:0: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
rows.quest:96630:title: The Adventurer [⟦E4⟧]
rows.quest:96630:obj:0: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
rows.quest:96630:details:0: <The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
rows.quest:96630:details:1: There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
rows.quest:96634:title: Camping 101: ⟦E9⟧ [⟦E4⟧]
rows.quest:96656:title: The Adventurer [⟦E5⟧]
rows.quest:96656:details:0: , you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the ⟦E12⟧ so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
rows.quest:96656:details:1: I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by ⟦E11⟧. Go and see what she's doing.
rows.quest:96658:title: Camping 101: ⟦E9⟧
rows.quest:96658:obj:0: Speak with ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧ to learn to become a cook.
rows.quest:96658:details:0: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, ⟦5⟧. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
rows.quest:96658:details:1: ⟦E9⟧'s not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
rows.quest:96658:progress:0: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
rows.quest:96658:completion:0: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
rows.quest:96658:completion:1: Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
rows.quest:96658:completion:2: You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
rows.quest:96659:title: The Adventurer [⟦E3⟧]
rows.quest:96659:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E13⟧ to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:96659:details:0: Wait, . I have another ask of you, before you leave us.
rows.quest:96659:details:1: There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
